cases.condition: Exact v0.4.1 synthetic profile and immutable declarative artifacts pass every selected local technical gate.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain the synthetic package and obtain legal real-artifact evidence before promotion review.

cases.condition: Provider tag, source revision, Python identity, dependency lock, or environment profile is unpinned or drifted.
cases.minimum_next_action: Create and forward-validate an exact provider and environment profile.

cases.condition: Artifact bytes disagree with the request hash, or result model hashes detach from network or thermochemistry bytes.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore immutable bytes or issue one reviewed lineage replacement.

cases.condition: An elementary reaction has undefined species or violates elemental or site balance.
cases.minimum_next_action: Correct the declarative network before adding kinetic evidence.

cases.condition: Energy, pressure, temperature, coverage, rate unit, or active-site normalization is missing or unsupported.
cases.minimum_next_action: Normalize units and bind rate values to one declared active-site basis.

cases.condition: Species energy or provenance is incomplete, or forward and reverse barriers violate thermodynamic cycle closure.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve references, energy components, provenance, and barriers before solving.

cases.condition: Solver self-reports convergence but residual, tolerance, multi-start count, fingerprints, or final coverages disagree.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve every branch and rerun the predeclared initialization set with stored residuals and final states.

cases.condition: Coverage bounds, site closure, or stoichiometrically derived surface-species production residuals fail.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve site accounting, rate mapping, and the selected steady-state branch.

cases.condition: Calibration and evaluation IDs overlap, sensitivity branches or scales are incomplete, or uncertainty evidence is incomplete.
cases.minimum_next_action: Separate data partitions and complete branch-bound sensitivity and uncertainty evidence.

cases.condition: Automation is asked to assert a true or unique mechanism, unique steady state, rate-determining step, causal ranking, or experiment agreement.
cases.minimum_next_action: Limit output to conditional technical evidence and obtain an independent scientific decision.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from exact bounded evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop and obtain enough exact bounded evidence to select one earlier case deterministically.
